name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Mushroom Chicken Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 2-3 medium)
1 1/2 cups heavy cream (or light cream, or half & half)
2 tablespoons fresh herb of choice, optional
why: Verified from source: 569 cal / 30g protein / 7g carb per serving - mid-band calories, very low carb, 30g protein clears the high-protein identity. One-skillet creamy pan sauce, no rice/pasta base, scales cleanly to 14 by weigh-and-divide. Distinct from accepted chicken-marsala-skillet (marsala wine) and creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet (spinach/sun-dried tomato) - this is a garlic-parmesan mushroom cream with no wine. Every ingredient maps to the Omaha board (chicken-breast, mushrooms, onions, garlic, butter, olive-oil, heavy-cream, parmesan, garlic-powder, dried-oregano/italian-seasoning, paprika, fresh-basil).
